summary: Iter30 PM Toolkit + Iter29 Tax Toolkit + 3 iter23 UI bug retests. Backend: 23/23 PASS (11 tax + 12 PM) via /app/backend/tests/test_iter29_tax_toolkit.py and /app/backend/tests/test_iter30_pm_toolkit.py — all CRUD on projects/tasks/materials/diary works, public /api/pm/public/{token} returns 200 without auth and 404 on bad/rotated tokens, /api/billing/pricing exposes toolkits.pm (29.99/19.99) AND toolkits.tax AND toolkits.invoice AND bundle 39.99/24.99, RBAC blocks homeowners with 403 on both /api/tax/* and /api/pm/*, Tax CSVs are DATEV-shaped, year-end PDF returns %PDF bytes >1500. Frontend end-to-end (1366x900 + 414x900 mobile): the 3 iter23 UI bugs are NOW FIXED — (1) /messages: 0 React errors, 0 'Maximum update depth' on mount (was 24+ before); (2) /my-quotes Won tab: 0 max-depth errors; (3) MyInvoices list-card Share button (testid is `myinv-share-{id}` — NOT `myinv-open-share-{id}` as the review spec said) opens myinv-share-modal with whatsapp/target/note/inapp-send all mounted; (4) Mobile More sheet on 414px mounts data-testid=mobile-nav-more-sheet with all 6 tiles (My Quotes, My Invoices, Tax, Projects, Billing, Settings). NEW Tax page /tax: 7 tabs all present (Dashboard/USt-VA/EÜR/Mileage/SVS/Receipts/Reports), 4 dashboard tiles (Revenue/Outstanding/Expenses/Profit) populated, USt-VA Q1-Q4 selector works, Reports tab contains DATEV CSV + year-end PDF download. NEW PM /projects: list renders, bootstrap dropdown 'Create project from a won job' present, 1 existing project row links to /projects/<id>. /projects/<id> detail: 4 tabs (Kanban/Materials/Diary/Customer) render with 3 kanban columns (To do/In progress/Done), Customer tab exposes Copy/Rotate/Open public share-link with /p/<token>. Public /p/<token> renders WITHOUT app chrome (no header/footer) and shows progress + Pro snapshot. ONE NEW BLOCKER FOUND: the All-in-One Bundle card is NOT rendered on /billing — searching 0 occurrences of 'Bundle', 'All-in-One', '39,99', '24,99' in /billing DOM; only the 3 toolkit cards (Invoice/Tax/PM) render. The backend pricing API DOES return bundle data correctly (verified in test_pricing_includes_all_toolkits_and_bundle PASS), so this is a pure frontend rendering gap on BillingPage.jsx.
